description: Native Apple Metal rendering backend for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric) on macOS

mods.name: Ingot
mods.description: A native Apple Metal rendering backend for Minecraft on macOS.

releases.notes:
Ingot for Minecraft snapshot 26.4-snapshot-6 (Fabric Loader 0.20.1, Java 25). macOS on Apple silicon. Pre-release: snapshots change Minecraft's rendering API, so this build works with 26.4-snapshot-6 only.

A port of the 26.3 release: the same Metal renderer, power modes and Modrinth profile, adapted to the snapshot's render pass layouts.

Tested on a MacBook Pro (M4 Pro): build, the visual tour and the power-mode test pass on Metal, and the screenshots match vanilla. The performance numbers on ingot.ericomg.com were measured on 26.3.

**Install**
- Modrinth App: open `Ingot-0.1.0+mc26.4-snapshot-6.mrpack`, then set the profile's memory to 4096 MB and its Java arguments to `-XX:+UseG1GC -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=40 -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UseStringDeduplication`
- Any launcher: put `ingot-0.1.0+mc26.4-snapshot-6.jar` in the mods folder of a Fabric profile for 26.4-snapshot-6. No other mods needed.

releases.notes:
Ingot for Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric Loader 0.19.5, Java 25). macOS on Apple silicon.

A port of the 26.3 release: the same Metal renderer, power modes (Auto, Performance, Battery under Options > Video Settings) and Modrinth profile. 26.2 uses an older form of Minecraft's backend API, so Ingot opens its Metal layer on 26.2's GLFW window and compiles its pipelines itself.

Tested on a MacBook Pro (M4 Pro): build, the visual tour and the power-mode test pass on Metal, and the screenshots match vanilla OpenGL. The performance numbers on ingot.ericomg.com were measured on 26.3.

**Install**
- Modrinth App: open `Ingot-0.1.0+mc26.2.mrpack`, then set the profile's memory to 4096 MB and its Java arguments to `-XX:+UseG1GC -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=40 -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UseStringDeduplication`
- Any launcher: put `ingot-0.1.0+mc26.2.jar` in the mods folder of a Fabric 26.2 profile. No other mods needed.

releases.notes:
Ingot for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric Loader 0.19.5, Java 25). macOS on Apple silicon.

**Install**
- Modrinth App: open `Ingot-0.1.0+mc26.3.mrpack` to create a profile. Then in the profile's Java and memory settings, set memory to 4096 MB and these Java arguments: `-XX:+UseG1GC -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=40 -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UseStringDeduplication`
- Any launcher: put `ingot-0.1.0+mc26.3.jar` in the `mods` folder of a Fabric 26.3 profile. No other mods needed.

**What it does**
- Renders through Apple Metal instead of OpenGL.
- Power modes: Auto, Performance and Battery, under Options > Video Settings. Auto switches to Battery mode on battery power.
- Battery mode holds your display's refresh rate (120 fps on ProMotion) and runs chunk building on the efficiency cores.

**Measured on a MacBook Pro (M4 Pro)**, full resolution, 120 fps cap, compared with vanilla:
- Render distance 16: 31% less power, 1% lows 110 vs 73 fps.
- Render distance 32: 26% less energy per frame, holds 120 fps (vanilla: 100).
- Uncapped: 538 fps vs about 205.
- Memory with the profile's Java settings: 2.7 GB vs 5.7 GB.
